content:
Valero Energy (VLO) has been moving on a cluster of catalysts, including tight global fuel supplies, strong refining margins, and upbeat earnings revisions that have pushed the stock ahead of both the S&P 500 and its industry recently.

At a share price of US$387.18, Valero Energy has racked up a 30 day share price return of 11.25% and a 90 day gain of 49.28%, even after a recent 7 day pullback of 6.32% that cooled very short term momentum. Over a longer stretch, the stock's year to date share price return of 134.21% sits alongside a 1 year total shareholder return of 125.13% and a 5 year total shareholder return above 5x, reflecting strong multi year compounding in the background of the current move.

Scan how Valero Energy fits into the wider move in refiners by reviewing a hand picked set of 40 power grid technology and infrastructure stocks that could also benefit from sustained energy infrastructure demand.

Bulls point to tight fuel supplies, robust refining conditions, and upbeat earnings revisions. Bears flag the sharp multi month surge and rich expectations already in Valero Energy's price. Which side does the valuation math support?

Most Popular Narrative: 45% Overvalued

Valero Energy is trading at $387.18 against a widely followed fair value narrative of about $267.83. This frames the recent surge as rich relative to those long range assumptions while still hinging on strong refining economics.

The analysts have a consensus price target of $267.83 for Valero Energy based on their expectations of its future earnings growth, profit margins and other risk factors.

In order for you to agree with the analysts, you'd need to believe that by 2029, revenues will be $112.7 billion, earnings will come to $4.7 billion, and it would be trading on a PE ratio of 18.0x, assuming you use a discount rate of 7.1%.

See why 59 investors see Valero Energy as 45% overvalued .

Result: Fair Value of $267.83 (OVERVALUED)

Still, the story can change quickly if asset impairments, refinery closure costs or weaker renewable diesel economics affect Valero Energy's earnings power more than expected.

瓦莱罗能源公司 (VLO) 一直受到一系列催化剂的推动，包括全球燃料供应紧张、炼油利润强劲以及乐观的盈利修正，这些因素最近推动该股领先于标准普尔 500 指数及其行业。

以 387.18 美元的股价计算，Valero Energy 的 30 天股价回报率为 11.25%，90 天股价回报率为 49.28%，尽管最近 7 天回调了 6.32%，冷却了极短期的势头。从长远来看，该股今年迄今的股价回报率为 134.21%，而 1 年股东总回报率为 125.13%，5 年股东总回报率超过 5 倍，反映出当前走势背景下强劲的多年复利。

通过审查精心挑选的 40 只电网技术和基础设施股票，了解 Valero Energy 如何适应炼油厂的更广泛举措，这些股票也可能受益于持续的能源基础设施需求。

看多者指出燃料供应紧张、炼油条件强劲以及乐观的盈利修正。看空者标志着瓦莱罗能源公司价格已连续数月大幅上涨和丰富预期。估值数学支持哪一边？

最受欢迎的叙述：45% 被高估

Valero Energy 的交易价格为 387.18 美元，而广泛关注的公允价值约为 267.83 美元。这将近期的飙升视为相对于长期假设的丰厚回报，同时仍取决于强劲的炼油经济。

分析师根据对 Valero Energy 未来盈利增长、利润率和其他风险因素的预期，一致将其目标股价定为 267.83 美元。

为了让你同意分析师的观点，你需要相信到 2029 年，收入将达到 1127 亿美元，收益将达到 47 亿美元，并且假设你使用 7.1% 的贴现率，其市盈率为 18.0 倍。

了解为什么 59 名投资者认为 Valero Energy 的股价被高估了 45%。

结果：公允价值为 267.83 美元（估值过高）

尽管如此，如果资产减值、炼油厂关闭成本或可再生柴油经济疲软对瓦莱罗能源公司盈利能力的影响超出预期，情况可能会迅速发生变化。
